player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jokɛla {player_id} ɲɛ Indian Poker.
- 52-card kɛlɛntɛ; i bɛ sɛbɛn na jokɛla kɛ.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kɛlɛntɛ, {max_rounds} kɛlɛntɛ ɲɛgɛn.
- Kɛlɛntɛ dɔw kan: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ye kɛlɛntɛ kɛ sɔrɔ kan <= i chip kɔntɔ.)
- Sɛbɛn kɛlɛntɛ kɛ ye pot kɛ ɲɛgɛn.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Bɛɛ kɔnɔntɔn na kɛlɛntɛ kan, o kɛ '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ani '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: I tɛ se [check] - i bɛ ka wari don.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bèli / wulikajɔ ka kan ka kɛ 1 ye.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Foyi tɛ ka wele; i bɛ se [check] a nɔ na.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Ka [bet X] kɛ ka dayɛlɛ; a tɛ se ka wuli.
invalid_move.insufficient: Funteniw tɛ se ka kɛ o waleya kama.

board.possible_actions: I bɛ se ka min kɛ: {legal}

message.folded: Jalakɛla {player_id} ye a ka jɔ bila.
message.showdown_tie: Jate ye kelenye: u fila {card}. Banakɔta bɛ tila ka kɛ , bɛɛ ta bɛ sɔrɔ {split}.

outcome.draw: Fɛɛrɛ kelenw bɛɛ kɔfɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛ ko o ye tiɲɛni dɔ ye.
